heroHeadline: Container Ship Sunk in Strait of Hormuz as Iran Escalates Shipping Attacks
heroSubtitle: A container ship sank in the Strait of Hormuz after being struck by a projectile, marking a major escalation in Iran's intensifying campaign against commercial shipping ahead of US midterm elections
